reason: A browser-integrated file access plugin that lets an agent list, read, and, in supported secure contexts, write UTF-8 text files in a directory explicitly authorized by the user.

summaries.zh: 通过浏览器授权本地目录，让智能体列出、读取并在支持的安全上下文中写入其中的 UTF-8 文本文件。
summaries.en: Lets an agent list, read, and, in supported secure contexts, write UTF-8 text files in a local directory authorized through the browser.

capabilities: Reads files from a user-authorized browser-local directory
Writes UTF-8 text files within the authorized directory
Relays agent tool calls between the host and browser via WebSocket
Displays directory contents and previews supported files in the web interface
